title: Welcome
overview: New residents mean building new homes. There's just one problem: regular houses do not fit the needs of minotaurs and centaurs.

title: New Residents
overview: A change of plans is in order. If the current village can't support the new residents, the solution is simple: build more villages.

title: Winter
overview: The Great Tree Village experiences another winter.

title: Martial Arts Competition
overview: What better way to mark a celebration than with a martial arts competition?

title: Another Peaceful Day
overview: From curing an illness to cultivating new crops to even Mountain Elves curating Hiraku’s favor, life in the Great Tree Village is never dull.

title: Fine Day for Vistors
overview: Hiraku has his hands full as mayor. Not only is he tasked with a series of angelic trials, but he must also mediate a draconic relationship.

title: Hot Spring Expedition
overview: A hot springs expedition quickly gets out of hand.

title: More Hot Spring Expedition
overview: They've dealt with the Lord of Death. Now they need to decide what to do with the black stones.

title: Return to Ordinary
overview: A feast celebrates the excavation of the black stones.

title: Festivities and Fuushu's Gratitude
overview: The passage of time brings change. A new competition is held, Alfred grows older, and new settlers arrive.

title: Castle in the Air
overview: The village must face a flying castle inhabited by demons.

title: A Village for All
overview: Hiraku establishes the newly powered Sun Castle as his fourth village. During a grand festival, he unveils a unifying flag while lightheartedly dodging pressure to take on a royal title.
